programme.desc: American Skyper: The whole family are at Jay and Gloria's for Alex's graduation party, except for Phil, who's figured out a way to be there using Skype and a robotic vessel.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Thursdays with Abie: Grampa tells a journalist about his wartime service on a battleship. The story brings Grampa lots of attention, but his relationship with Homer suffers.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Once Upon a Time in Springfield: Krusty gets a beautiful new co-star (guest voice Anne Hathaway). Mr Burns withdraws the staff's free doughnuts at the nuclear power plant.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Million Dollar Maybe: Homer wins the lottery jackpot but has to keep it secret from the family. Guest starring Chris Martin from Coldplay.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Boy Meets Curl: When Homer takes Marge out for a romantic evening at the ice rink, they become hooked on curling and end up competing to reach the Winter Olympics.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Fear of Flying: Homer gets barred from Moe's and visits an airport bar, where he's mistaken for a pilot. Marge visits a psychiatrist to get to the bottom of her fear of flying.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer the Great: Homer becomes a member of a secret society, where the main man spots something significant on Homer's anatomy... Guest starring Patrick Stewart.

programme.title: The Great Celebrity Bake Off...
programme.desc: ...for Stand Up To Cancer: Oti Mabuse, Gabby Logan, David O'Doherty and Suzi Ruffell make ice cream rolls, a kids' party favourite and their biggest fear in meringue form.

programme.title: New: Cruising Paradise: Above &...
programme.desc: ...Below Deck: Brand new series - Love is in the air on the Star Princess, there's a crew changeover, and guests squeeze into tiny Scoot Coupes to explore Mexican island Cozumel. (Ep4)

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The Goggleboxers have been watching: The Coronation - and The Coronation Concert - First Dates, The 1% Club, The Greatest Auction, Made in Chelsea and BBC News (local elections).
